summary: Verified Weekly Self Journey Note feature (backend units, email template, HTTP unsubscribe, cron auth, crons.yml) and the updated welcome artwork ('Understand Your Co-Parenting Relationship' on 2 lines) across landing, Self Journey, and Court Ordered doors. All 16 new tests pass; regression tests (release_check, self_assessment_reminders, foundation_builder, foundation_builder_http = 19 tests) all pass; admin release-checks still returns ok with 9 results.
verified: build_highlights full example and singular variants (SA/day/cn) produce exact strings per spec
make_unsubscribe_token round-trip; reassess-reminder token (different kind) correctly rejected

send_weekly_notes: sends exactly one email to active user with correct cta_url=/dashboard and unsubscribe_url=/api/self-journey/weekly-note/unsubscribe?token=... ; skips safety-flagged (portal_state.safety_ack.flagged), unsubscribed (self_journey_weekly_prefs.unsubscribed), guest, bounced; activity >7d (stale foundation_builder updated_at) does not count; second run in same ISO week yields already_sent

send_self_journey_weekly_note: subject exactly 'Your weekly note'; highlights HTML-escaped ('<Foundation>' -> <Foundation>); HTML contains 'Open my Self Journey' CTA and 'Unsubscribe' link; plain text contains full unsubscribe URL
GET .../unsubscribe?token=garbage -> 400 'Link not valid'; reassess-reminder token -> 400 (kind mismatch)
POST /api/cron/self-journey-weekly-note -> 401 unauth / 401 wrong bearer / 200 with correct bearer (WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET)
Images: /images/sa-welcome.webp?v=2 and sa-welcome-768.webp?v=2 both return HTTP 200 image/webp
Frontend doors: door-welcome-image (landing), door-self-welcome-image (Self Journey), door-court-welcome-image (Court) all render; hotspots door-welcome-hotspot-self/court/comm present

Individual Journey checklist (zoom screenshot) reads exactly: Co-Parenting Self-Assessment / Understand Your Co-Parenting Relationship (2 lines) / Identify Your Child's Specific Needs / Create Your Foundation Statement / Track Your Progress — no overlaps or artifacts
Admin POST /api/admin/release-checks/run returns ok=true with 9 results
note_on_cron: Authorized cron POST was called once to confirm 200 (returns {ok:true, enqueued:'self-journey-weekly-note'}). Background work may have sent sandboxed-Resend emails to users with activity this week; prior iteration already verified this manually (see /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log).
critical_code_review_comments: self_journey_weekly.collect_activity scans entire collections for the 7-day window on every cron run — fine today but consider adding indexes on {completed_at, user_id} / {date, user_id} / {updated_at, user_id} as volume grows.

No lower bound on cp_report_history snapshot count — if a snapshot has falsy submitted_at it is treated as empty string and compared with >= since, which is correct, but worth adding unit coverage if cp_report path is exercised heavily.
